testNames: consumer captures preserve exact text, independent mode/entry and observed metadata
invalid URLs, timestamps, missing dimensions and unknown versions fail before saving
citations deduplicate, unknown labels stay out of denominators, mention is not recommendation
save/retry keeps one original and changed raw evidence conflicts instead of silently succeeding
parallel identical saves settle at one capture and historical question identity survives current-version changes
legacy equal captures remain recoverable and review labels are not overwritten by a retry
import endpoint enforces writable role and brand scope
lost response keeps stable capture id and refuses changed payload until original retry resolves
form renders actual mode input and historical versions without inferring a model
adopted source titles and unknown review labels survive the save and lost-response retry
same-condition consumer retest links baseline and rejects changed context or cross-brand references
target results exclude API, trial, other entities, different questions and missing snapshots
unprompted recommendations require original name-free question, online mode, mention and explicit review
an empty goal stays unknown and historical wording is not replaced by the current target
limitations: 不是客户交付或收益证明
